title: Chuông chùa xa
about: A new piece in the dem-diu style (round 12): 50 bpm, modal D minor (a pentatonic tune, D F G A C, and no leading tone), the left hand rolled and held like a bell's ring (blocks), sus chords and Bbmaj7, a low drone at the start and end; the B part strikes D6 twice like a far bell and touches E over Bb (a Lydian glint).
